objections.reason: 'vigilance' is already the children's rendering of saṃprajanya (T047); apramāda (carefulness) needs a distinct word.
Keeps the pair apramāda/pramāda symmetrical with T121 'prudence'; 'inattention' would collide with smṛti 'attention'.
īrṣyā is established as 'jalousie'; 'envie' is ambiguous (desire) and collides with 'envie' used for craving (T157).
'existence' is already the rendering of bhava (T086); tshe rabs/janman means a lifetime, so 'vie'.
'Protecteur' is already used for nātha (T045, T087); tāyin/skyob pa is 'Saviour' in the academic field, so keep it distinct.
mya ngan is sorrow, not duḥkha; inconsistent with T060 'libération du chagrin' and clashes with souffrance (T001).
Same term tṛṣṇā is 'soif' in T081; academic renderings must agree.
Match T081 children; bare 'envie' is too weak for craving.
Same term sūtra is 'texte d'enseignement' in T125; 'texte sacré' is already used for āgama (T085).
'matière première' means industrial raw material in French and misleads; 'originelle' conveys primal.
Same term svārtha; align with T064 and the 'bien d'autrui' (parārtha) pairing; 'bien propre' is unidiomatic.
Same term svārtha is 'son propre bien' in T064; the periphrasis is inconsistent.
'tristesse' is also the children's rendering of daurmanasya (T240); 'chagrin' keeps śoka distinct and matches nirvāṇa 'chagrin'.
Same term bāla as T065, which has 'personne immature'; 'sotte' is insulting and gendered for readers aged 8-12.
'Accoutumance' connotes addiction in French; goms pa is established as 'familiarisation'.
Sense is 'child'; other sras compounds (T110, T113) use 'enfant', not 'fils'.

objections.proposed: enfant de Celui qui est bien allé
objections.reason: Sugata is 'Celui qui est bien allé' in T052; 'Bien-Allé' is inconsistent and hard for children.
saṃprajanya is 'vigilance' in T047 children; 'rester attentif' loses the term and the 'guarding' sense.
Simpler for ages 8-12 than 'renommée', and matches T424 and T482 which already use 'célébrité'.
'vœux' is also 'vow' (saṃvara, T305); 'souhaits' is used for the same wish-fulfilling notion in T114, T625.
